plugins.name: costar-coach-plugin
plugins.description: Use when asked to convert to COSTAR, make this a COSTAR prompt, rewrite / improve / structure this prompt, or mentions the COSTAR framework, to turn a plain description into a well-structured prompt using the COSTAR methodology (Context, Objective, Style, Tone, Audience, Response). 支持中文触发，如转成COSTAR格式、用COSTAR框架改写、优化/结构化这个提示词等同类表达。

plugins.name: crispe-coach-plugin
plugins.description: Use when asked to convert to CRISPE, make this a CRISPE prompt, rewrite / improve / structure this prompt, or mentions the CRISPE framework, to turn a plain description into a well-structured prompt using the CRISPE methodology (Context, Role, Instruction, Specification, Performance, Example). 支持中文触发，如转成CRISPE格式、用CRISPE框架改写、优化/结构化这个提示词等同类表达。

plugins.name: auto-skill-update-plugin
plugins.description: Use when asked to update, extend, or fix a skill definition -- e.g. update the skill to cover X / add this case to skill / the skill missed this case / fix the skill, or any phrasing about correcting a skill. 支持中文触发，如更新这个skill、给skill加上这个情况、skill漏了这个情况等同类表达。Invoke immediately on these signals; the worthiness assessment and confirmation happen inside the skill, not before invoking.

plugins.name: prompt-convert-trigger-plugin
plugins.description: Use proactively when a request would benefit from structured prompt engineering -- involves complexity, vagueness, multi-step work, or spans multiple concerns -- converting it into a COSTAR or CRISPE prompt before executing; don't wait for an explicit ask. 支持中文触发信号，如多目标表达（修复X同时让Y也能工作）、不确定表达（我不确定怎么、可能是）、模糊动词（改进、优化）等同类情况。

plugins.name: crispe-system-architect-plugin
plugins.description: Use when asked to analyze a repo, generate STRUCTURE.md / ARCHITECTURE.md / OVERVIEW.md / CLAUDE.md / CONTRIBUTING.md, map architecture, or explain job inputs, outputs and data flows with Mermaid diagrams. 支持分析仓库、梳理项目结构、生成架构文档、说明作业输入输出和流程图；支持中文、English 和中英双语输出。 Also offers documentation before code changes when architecture/context docs are absent. Supports a structure reference, a contribution guide plus structure reference, or an AI context file.

plugins.name: crispe-commit-composer-plugin
plugins.description: Use when asked to commit changes, save work to git, check in code, create a commit, or ship the current changes -- e.g. commit this / let's commit / save this to git / create a commit for X. 支持中文触发，如提交代码、提交这些改动、帮我commit等同类表达。Does not trigger on questions about commit history (e.g. what does this commit do, show me the last commit). Groups the working tree into logically ordered, size-capped commits (code -> test -> doc) under one stable "[feature]: summary" format per branch, verifies the build before committing code when detected, and keeps a safety backup so a mid-sequence failure can be rolled back without losing work.
